# connectracer_wisdom_assistant_ai_agents (Resource)

Manages the AI Agent configuration for an existing Amazon Q in Connect (Wisdom) Assistant. This resource manages AI Agent assignments separately from the assistant itself to avoid dependency cycles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Assign a default SELF_SERVICE AI agent to a Q in Connect assistant.
# Use agent_id:$LATEST or agent_id:version_number as the value.
resource "connectracer_wisdom_assistant_ai_agents" "self_service" {
  assistant_id = "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"

  ai_agent_configuration = {
    SELF_SERVICE = "97a0c52f-aaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddddddddddd:$LATEST"
  }
}

# Orchestration agent for chat self-service.
# orchestrator_use_cases is required when assigning an ORCHESTRATION agent.
resource "connectracer_wisdom_assistant_ai_agents" "orchestration" {
  assistant_id = "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"

  ai_agent_configuration = {
    ORCHESTRATION = "539eb230-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee:$LATEST"
  }

  orchestrator_use_cases = {
    ORCHESTRATION = "Connect.SelfService"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ai_agent_configuration` (Map of String) The AI Agent configuration for the assistant. A map of AI Agent type to the qualified AI Agent ID (with version qualifier, e.g., `agent_id:$LATEST` or `agent_id:version_number`). Valid keys include `ANSWER_RECOMMENDATION`, `MANUAL_SEARCH`, `SELF_SERVICE`, and `ORCHESTRATION`.
- `assistant_id` (String) The ID of the Amazon Q in Connect assistant.

### Optional

- `orchestrator_use_cases` (Map of String) Optional map of AI Agent type to orchestrator use case. Required for `ORCHESTRATION` (e.g. `Connect.SelfService` for chat self-service).
